title: Prōnōmen Relātīvum
subtitle: Dēclīnātiō plēna ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (quī, quae, quod), similis articulō sed cum spīritū aspero constanti; rēgula attractiōnis.
objectives: Dēclīnāre plēnē prōnōmen relātīvum ὅς, ἥ, ὅ per omnēs cāsūs, utrōque numerō
Distinguere ὅς relātīvum (spīritū aspero, accentū ubīque) ab articulō ὁ (spīritū aspero etiam, sed prōclīticō) per contextum syntacticum
Formāre clausulās relātīvās simplicēs, applicandō concordantiam relātīvī cum antecedente in genere/numerō (nōn in cāsū)
Recognōscere rēgulam attractiōnis: relātīvum interdum “attrahitur” in cāsum antecedentis, contrā logicam propriam clausulae

content.intro: Ἀγάθων λέγει· ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν. Notāvistī: ὃς λέγει — “quī loquitur”, clausula intrā sententiam. Hodiē discis prōnōmen relātīvum ὅς, ἥ, ὅ.
content.explanation:
Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν.” Μελίτη λέγει· “Καὶ οἱ πολῖται οὓς φιλῶ ἀγαθοί εἰσιν.” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Τὰ δῶρα ἃ ἔπεμψας καλά ἐστιν — καὶ ἡ πόλις ἧς τοὺς νόμους τιμῶμεν εὐτυχής ἐστιν.” (Agathōn dīcit: “Vir quī loquitur sapiēns est.” Melitē dīcit: “Et cīvēs quōs amō bonī sunt.” Agathōn dīcit: “Dōna quae mīsistī pulchra sunt — et urbs cuius lēgēs honōrāmus fēlīx est.”)

Notāvistīne ὅς, οὕς, ἅ, ἧς — quattuor fōrmae, cāsus dīversus quisque? Concordantia relātīvī sequitur rēgulam duplicem: relātīvum concordat cum antecedente (nōmen ad quod refert) in genere et numerō, sed cāsus relātīvī est dētermīnātus ā FŪNCTIŌNE SUĀ PROPRIĀ intrā clausulam relātīvam ipsam (subiectum, obiectum, etc.), NŌN ā cāsū antecedentis. Comparā Latīnum: eadem rēgula fundāmentālis valet.

rules.heading: a) Ὅς, Ἥ, Ὅ: Dēclīnātiō Plēna
rules.body:
CāsusMasc. sg.Fem. sg.Neut. sg.
Nōm.ὅςἥὅ
Gen.οὗἧςοὗ
Dat.ᾧᾗᾧ
Acc.ὅνἥνὅ

Plūrālis: masc. οἵ, ὧν, οἷς, οὕς — fem. αἵ, ὧν, αἷς, ἅς — neut. ἅ, ὧν, οἷς, ἅ. Comparā cum articulō (ὁ, ἡ, τό): fōrmae sunt phōnēticē propinquae sed relātīvum semper accipit accentum proprium (interdum acūtum, interdum circumflexum), NUMQUAM prōclīticum.

rules.heading: b) Rēgula Concordantiae Fundāmentālis
rules.body: Genus et numerus relātīvī sequuntur antecedentem; cāsus sequitur fūnctiōnem propriam intrā clausulam relātīvam: ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃν ὁρῶ “vir quem videō” (ὁρῶ requīrit accūsātīvum, ergō ὅν, quamquam ἀνήρ ipse est nōminātīvus in clausulā prīncipālī). ἡ γυνὴ ἧς τὸ βιβλίον ἐστίν “mulier cuius liber est” (ἧς genetīvus possessīvus, dēterminātus ā fūnctiōne intrā clausulam relātīvam).

rules.heading: c) Rēgula Attractiōnis (Nōta Avanceāta)
rules.body: Frequenter — praesertim cum antecedēns est in genetīvō vel datīvō, et relātīvum “dēberet” esse in accūsātīvō — relātīvum “attrahitur” in cāsum antecedentis, contrā rēgulam normālem: τῆς πόλεως ἧς ὁρῶ (litt. “urbis, quam videō”, ubi ἧς genetīvus est attrāctus ex accūsātīvō expectātō ἥν, propter genetīvum antecedentis πόλεως). Haec est ēlegantia stylistica frequēns in prōsā Atticā, magis quam error — nōta eam nunc, sed nōlī sentīre obligātus applicāre eam tuā ipsīus scrīptiōne adhūc.

examples: ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν. — Vir quī loquitur sapiēns est. (ὅς nōm., subiectum clausulae relātīvae)
ἡ γυνὴ ἣν ὁρῶ καλή ἐστιν. — Mulier quam videō pulchra est. (ἥν acc., obiectum)
ὁ δοῦλος ᾧ δίδωμι τὸ βιβλίον. — Servus cui dō librum. (ᾧ dat.)
οἱ πολῖται οὓς φιλῶ ἀγαθοί εἰσιν. — Cīvēs quōs amō bonī sunt. (οὕς acc. pl.)
τὰ δῶρα ἃ ἔπεμψας καλά ἐστιν. — Dōna quae mīsistī pulchra sunt. (ἅ nōm./acc. pl. neut.)
ἡ πόλις ἧς τοὺς νόμους τιμῶμεν. — Urbs cuius lēgēs honōrāmus. (ἧς gen.)

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere prōnōmen relātīvum ὅς cum articulō ὁ, propter fōrmam phōnēticē similem.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere per accentum: relātīvum semper habet accentum proprium vīsibilem; articulus ὁ/ἡ/οἱ/αἱ est prōclīticus (sine accentū) in fōrmīs nōminātīvīs.
commonMistakes.why: Cōnfūsiō hīc impedit intellēctum syntacticum: articulus intrōdūcit nōmen, relātīvum intrōdūcit clausulam integram.

commonMistakes.wrong: Dēterminā cāsum relātīvī ā cāsū antecedentis, potius quam ā fūnctiōne relātīvī intrā clausulam suam.
commonMistakes.right: Semper analyzāre: quid facit relātīvum intrā clausulam relātīvam ipsam (subiectum? obiectum? possessor?) — id dētermīnat cāsum, nōn cāsus antecedentis.
commonMistakes.why: Error frequēns apud incipientēs quī applicant analogiam falsam cum concordantiā adiectīvī-nōminis (ubi cāsus semper concordat).

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere attractiōnem esse error grammaticus quandō occurrit in textū authenticō.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere attractiōnem ut phaenomenon stylisticum lēgitimum et frequēns, nōn errōrem.
commonMistakes.why: Discipulus quī nōn nōvit hoc phaenomenon potest cōnfundī legendō textūs authenticōs ubi attractiō occurrit.

exercises.title: Ὁ Ἀνὴρ Ὃς Λέγει
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.
exercises.passage: Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν.” Μελίτη λέγει· “Καὶ οἱ πολῖται οὓς φιλῶ ἀγαθοί εἰσιν.” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Τὰ δῶρα ἃ ἔπεμψας καλά ἐστιν — καὶ ἡ πόλις ἧς τοὺς νόμους τιμῶμεν εὐτυχής ἐστιν.”

items.explanation: “Ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν.”

items.prompt: Quālēs sunt cīvēs quōs Melitē amat?
items.explanation: “Οἱ πολῖται οὓς φιλῶ ἀγαθοί εἰσιν.”

items.prompt: Quālia sunt dōna quae Melitē mīsit?
items.explanation: “Τὰ δῶρα ἃ ἔπεμψας καλά ἐστιν.”

items.prompt: Quālis est urbs cuius lēgēs honōrāmus?
items.explanation: “Ἡ πόλις ἧς τοὺς νόμους τιμῶμεν εὐτυχής ἐστιν.”

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine cāsūs relātīvī.

items.statement: Vir quī loquitur est stultus, secundum Ἀγάθωνem.
items.explanation: Falsum: “ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς λέγει σοφός ἐστιν” — sapiēns, nōn stultus.

items.statement: Cīvēs quōs Μελίτη amat sunt malī.
items.explanation: Falsum: “οἱ πολῖται οὓς φιλῶ ἀγαθοί εἰσιν” — bonī.

items.statement: Dōna quae Μελίτη mīsit sunt turpia.
items.explanation: Falsum: “τὰ δῶρα ἃ ἔπεμψας καλά ἐστιν” — pulchra.

items.statement: Urbs cuius lēgēs honōrāmus est fēlīx.
items.explanation: “Ἡ πόλις ἧς τοὺς νόμους τιμῶμεν εὐτυχής ἐστιν.”

options: fūnctiō relātīvī intrā clausulam relātīvam ipsam
items.explanation: Cāsus sequitur fūnctiōnem propriam intrā clausulam relātīvam.
Genus et numerus semper concordant cum antecedente.

items.prompt: Quid distinguit ὅς relātīvum ab ὁ articulō?
options: accentus: relātīvum semper accentuātum, articulus prōclīticus in fōrmīs nōminātīvīs
items.explanation: Discrīmen praecipuum est accentuāle/syntacticum.

options: phaenomenon ubi relātīvum accipit cāsum antecedentis, contrā rēgulam normālem
items.explanation: Attractiō est phaenomenon stylisticum lēgitimum, frequēns in prōsā Atticā.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma genetīvī singulāris fēminīnī ὅς/ἥ/ὅ?
items.explanation: Genetīvus singulāris fēminīnus: ἧς.

exercises.title: Complē cum Fōrmā Rēctā
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis relātīvī.

items.prompt: ὁ ἀνὴρ ___ λέγει σοφός ἐστιν. (nōm. sg. masc., subiectum clausulae)
items.explanation: Nōminātīvus singulāris masculīnus, subiectum: ὅς.

items.prompt: ἡ γυνὴ ___ ὁρῶ. (acc. sg. fem., obiectum, “quam videō”)
items.explanation: Accūsātīvus singulāris fēminīnus, obiectum: ἥν.

items.prompt: ὁ δοῦλος ___ δίδωμι τὸ δῶρον. (dat. sg. masc., “cui dō”)
items.explanation: Datīvus singulāris masculīnus: ᾧ.

items.prompt: οἱ πολῖται ___ φιλῶ. (acc. pl. masc., “quōs amō”)
items.explanation: Accūsātīvus plūrālis masculīnus: οὕς.

items.prompt: τὰ δῶρα ___ ἔπεμψας. (nōm./acc. pl. neut., “quae mīsistī”)
items.explanation: Nōminātīvus/accūsātīvus plūrālis neutrī: ἅ.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Relātīvum concordat cum antecedente in genere et numerō, sed nōn necessāriē in cāsū.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: cāsus est dētermīnātus ā fūnctiōne relātīvī intrā suam propriam clausulam.

items.statement: Prōnōmen relātīvum ὅς est prōclīticum, sīcut articulus ὁ.
items.explanation: Falsum: relātīvum semper accipit accentum proprium.

items.statement: Attractiō relātīvī est semper error grammaticus, quod discipulus dēbet ēvītāre in scrīptiōne propriā.
items.explanation: Falsum: est phaenomenon stylisticum lēgitimum in textibus authenticīs, quamquam nōn requīsītum in scrīptiōne discipulī.

items.statement: Dēclīnātiō ὅς/ἥ/ὅ est phōnēticē similis articulō, differēns praecipuē in spīritū et accentū.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: ambō adhibent spīritum asperum, sed accentus differt (proprius vs. prōclīticus).

summary: Ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relātīvum): nōm. ὅς/ἥ/ὅ, gen. οὗ/ἧς/οὗ, dat. ᾧ/ᾗ/ᾧ, acc. ὅν/ἥν/ὅ — plūrālis οἵ/αἵ/ἅ, ὧν, οἷς/αἷς/οἷς, οὕς/ἅς/ἅ.
Genus et numerus dē relātīvō sequuntur antecedentem; cāsus sequitur fūnctiōnem intrā clausulam relātīvam ipsam.
Discrīmen ab articulō: relātīvum semper habet accentum proprium (numquam prōclīticum).
Attractiō: relātīvum interdum accipit cāsum antecedentis (praesertim gen./dat.) prō stylō, phaenomenon lēgitimum, nōn error.
